transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Your Name]. What brings you in today?
I guess… what finally made me call is I’ve been having thoughts like, if I didn’t wake up tomorrow, maybe that would be easier. I don’t want to hurt myself, but it scared me.
How long have you been feeling this way?
About six months, I think. It’s been this low, flat feeling… and the things that usually help, like my art class or morning walks, just haven’t really lifted it.
Have you lost interest in your art class or morning walks, or do you still enjoy them but just feel down overall?
I try to still do them. Like, I’ll set out my paints, or I’ll go to pottery class… but then I’m just kind of sitting there, looking at everything. It doesn’t have that spark it used to.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, appetite, or energy levels along with this low feeling?

Mostly my energy, I guess. Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I still feel worn out. Little things at work, like opening the store or answering a few questions from staff… it just takes more out of me than it should. Even carrying groceries in feels like a lot sometimes.
Have you been feeling like you're not good enough, or been overly hard on yourself lately?
Yeah… a bit. I keep going over small mistakes at work, like if a display sign is crooked or someone I’m training looks confused. Then I start thinking I’m just… not very good at being a supervisor.
Have you ever felt this way before, like a low mood that lasted for a while, maybe even weeks or months?
Yes… this has been going on for a while. I’d say about six months, maybe. It’s just been this low, flat feeling, and things like my art class or my walks don’t really help the way they used to.
Have you had episodes of low mood like this before, lasting longer than a couple of weeks, or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for such a long period?
I think this is the longest it’s been. It’s been… maybe around six months now, this flat, low feeling. My usual things, like art class or morning walks, just haven’t really lifted it.
Before this current six-month period, have you had other times when your mood was low for a while—like weeks or even months—or is this the first time you’ve felt this way for such an extended period?
I’m not really sure. I mean, I’ve had rough patches before, but I don’t know that they lasted like this. This one feels like the first time it’s gone on this long.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?
I don’t think so… not for two months like that. I’ve had down periods, but I can’t really say they were that steady or that long before this.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?
Before this… I don’t really think so. Lately, though, most mornings I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, like everything’s already dulled before I even get ready for the store.
Before this current period, have you ever had to take time off work, stop enjoying things completely, or feel like you were in a fog for weeks at a time because of your mood?

I don’t know that I took time off, exactly. But… with painting, or pottery, I’ll still set things out or go to class, and then I just sort of sit there looking at the materials. It doesn’t feel like it used to. That spark just isn’t really there.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?

I don’t really remember a stretch like that before. It’s more… lately, most mornings I wake up and everything feels kind of gray, like the color’s gone out of the day before I even get dressed for work.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?
I… I don’t think I had anything like that before. It’s really more lately—most mornings I wake up feeling heavy, sort of gray, like the color’s gone out before I even get dressed for the store.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?
I don’t think so… not before this. It’s more lately that most mornings I wake up with this heavy, gray feeling, like the color’s gone out before I even get dressed for the store.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two months?
I don’t think so… not before this. Lately, though, most mornings I wake up feeling heavy, like everything’s kind of gray before I even get dressed for the store.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks to a month, even if it didn't last as long as this current period?
Not really before this, no. It’s mostly lately… most mornings I wake up with that heavy, gray feeling, like everything’s lost its color before I even get ready for work.
Have you ever received any treatment for depression, like therapy or medication, for a previous low mood, and if so, did it help?
No, I haven’t had treatment for depression before… not therapy or medication for that, anyway.
Have you ever had two or more separate periods in the past where you felt down nearly every day for most of the day, even if they didn't last as long as this current one?
